خُبْلٌ : see خَبَالٌ. ＝
-A2- وَقَعَ فِى خُبْلِى It came into my mind; (JK, K;) a phrase like the saying, سَقَطَ فِى يَدِى: (JK, K: * [in the K, meaning the same as this saying:]) and sometimes (JK) one says also ↓ فِى خَبْلِى . (JK [and so in the K accord. to the TA, but not in the CK, nor in my MS. copy of the K].)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
